## More natural release videos

Editorial videos follow real app interactions, explain results with readable emphasis, and use inline code styling for API names and other code in prose. The skill keeps source details in production notes, uses the requested release version in videos, and checks that demo footage has no distracting explanatory footers.

Shiny logos are now optional and disabled by default, so branding can be added during editing. Both agent and Claude skill packages include the updated guidance.

New productions automatically verify and pin this release. Existing productions keep their current snapshot.
